_doc: Filter rules for visualization/qc.py — the single source of truth for thresholds, category metadata, colors, and page layout. qc.py loads this at startup; edit values here instead of editing the script. Pass --filters <path> to override per-run.

thresholds._doc: Numeric cutoffs used by classify() and the extent computation.

projection._doc: First-frame projection verdict and frame-jump threshold. The tip is treated as a static point in the camera frame; its world path is projected onto color_000000.png with the recorded intrinsics. VERDICT = end window only (see category rule); start window computed as evidence. HSV gates chosen by the 2026-10-16 corpus sweep (1138 eps): hue 10/160, s>=60, v>=60, n_red_min=200 catches 10/20 manual-bad with 1.9% false positives; the old RGB test both missed yellow-backboard cases and cannot be tuned to catch them.

berry._doc: Physical berry-capsule model. The rig camera looks down camera_pitch_deg from horizontal (30 deg mount + ~15 deg operator habit), no roll, so world-down in the optical frame is (0,cos,sin). Berries hang along it. The pick point (trajectory endpoint) sits pick_above_calyx 5-20mm above the calyx (top of a 40mm region sphere), so the berry center lies 25-40mm below the endpoint: the detection REGION is that 40mm sphere swept along world-down, projected to the image (union of sampled discs). The red-pixel THRESHOLD is decoupled from the region: a 30mm all-red berry disc projected at the capsule-top depth (closest, strictest) x red_area_fraction.

red_hsv._doc: Red hue lives at both ends of the H circle; s/v gates reject white glare and dark shadow.

categories._doc: Ordered classification chain. classify() evaluates categories by priority (lowest first); first match wins. Each entry: color (hex), problem (bool — counts against session in summary + sort), priority (int — lower sorts to top of page), rule + description (documentation only). All check numbers go to the CSV as evidence regardless of the final label, so thresholds can be re-judged without re-scanning.

not_processed.rule: trajectory/gripper stream missing, too short, or repair ledger absent
not_processed.description: Plumbing guard: an upstream step did not run — not a data verdict

traj_long_gap.rule: CameraTrajectory_idx.txt contains rows with state 'invalid' (tracking gap longer than gap_max_frames)
traj_long_gap.description: Long tracking loss — trajectory has NaN rows

gripper_missing.description: AprilTag signal lost somewhere — action is incomplete

traj_frame_jump.rule: max per-frame step of the SMOOTHED trajectory > projection.v_max_mm
traj_frame_jump.description: Residual single-frame jump after smoothing — recovery glitch

first_frame_projection.rule: red-pixel count in the circle below the projected end point (on the first color frame) < projection.n_red_min. VERDICT USES THE END WINDOW ONLY — corpus sweep showed the start near-tip window has no discriminative power (median 0 for both good and bad); red_start stays as an evidence column
first_frame_projection.description: No strawberry below the trajectory end point (wrong trajectory or bad demo). 'Berry present in the first frame' remains a MANUAL judgment

gripper_not_closed.rule: mean of last thresholds.gripper_end_tail finite readings > thresholds.gripper_end_open_threshold
gripper_not_closed.description: Gripper still open at the end — grasp not completed (0=closed, 1=open)

display._doc: Plot appearance and page layout. Hex colors only.
